record.reason: Adaptive Spiking Neurons add learnable layer-wise membrane thresholds; 19 vision/language datasets are evaluated. Energy estimates are theoretical, not measured on neuromorphic hardware, with DVS validation left open. General SNNs do not establish generative LLM inference performance; weak architecture adjacency only.
record.title: Adaptive Spiking Neurons for Vision and Language Modeling
